# Preliminary results 

```{r}
#| message: false
#| echo: false

library(dagitty)
library(ggdag)
library(NatParksPalettes)

dag <- dagitty::dagitty("
dag {
AD [exposure,pos=\"-0.830,0.001\"]
CS [exposure,pos=\"-1.742,0.507\"]
D [pos=\"-0.777,-0.410\"]
PT [exposure,pos=\"-1.519,-0.329\"]
PVS [exposure,pos=\"0.063,-0.981\"]
VE [outcome,pos=\"-1.742,-1.369\"]
VS [exposure,pos=\"1.355,-1.369\"]
VU [exposure,pos=\"-0.336,-0.722\"]
AD -> VE
CS -> AD
CS -> VE
D -> VE
D -> VU
PT -> VE
PVS -> VE
VS -> AD
VS -> VE
VU -> VE
}
")

tidy_dag <- 
  ggdag::tidy_dagitty(dag) |> 
  dplyr::mutate(Status = dplyr::case_when(
    name == "VE" ~ "Outcome",
    name == "D" ~ "Covariate",
    TRUE ~ "Exposure"
  ))  
  

# Optional: Plot or print summary
ggdag::ggdag(tidy_dag) +
  ggdag::geom_dag_point(ggplot2::aes(color = Status)) +
  ggdag::geom_dag_text() +
  ggdag::theme_dag() +
  NatParksPalettes::scale_color_natparks_d("Cuyahoga")

```


Term | Interpretation
--|--
AD| Antigenic distance between CS and VS 
CS|Prevalent circulating strain 
D|Demographic factors 
PT|Pre-season HAI titers 
PVS|Previous vaccine strain
VE|Vaccine efficacy
VS|Vaccine strain
